በእንተ: በእንተ — concerning, about (+ construct) · for the sake of, on account of (በእንተ ፍሥሓ አዳም 'for the joy of Adam') · 'because' before a perfect verb (በእንተ ተዘብጡ 'because they were struck') · 'because' before ዘ- + verb (በእንተ ዘነሥኦሙ 'because he took them'; በእንተ ዘአፍቀርኪያ 'because you loved her')
ሰረገላ: ሰረገላ — chariot (noun) · also 'cart' for the vehicle that carries the Ark among the baggage (ውስተ ሰረገላ 'onto a cart')
ወአውሥእዎ: አውሥአ — and they answered him (ወ- 'and' + 3mp perfect, causative አ- stem, w-ś-ʾ; + -ዎ 'him')
ወይቤልዎ: ብህለ — and they said to him (ወ- 'and' + 3mp perfect ይቤሉ of b-h-l + -ልዎ 'to him')
ሊቃነ: ሊቅ — chief, elder (noun; plural construct 'chiefs of')
መግረሬ: መግረሪ (?) — curb, bit, restrainer of (noun, construct; sense inferred from the bridle made of the nails, root uncertain) (?)
ፀር: ፀር — enemy (noun; genitive after the construct አህጉረ, 'of the enemy') · nominative, collective 'an enemy' (ወይበልዕ ፀር እለ ኢታአምር 'an enemy you do not know will eat')
ወእመሂ: እመ — and whether, or whether (ወ- 'and' + conjunction እመ + enclitic -ሂ)
ይነብር: ነበረ — he stays, dwells (3ms imperfect, G, n-b-r) · he sits, is seated (3ms imperfect, G, of sitting at table) · he will sit, take the seat (ዝንቱ ይነብር ህየንቴሁ 'this one will sit in his place')
እስከ: እስከ — until, as far as (preposition) · እስከ — conjunction before a verb, 'until' (እስከ የዐዝዞ ማይ 'until the water seizes him')
ከመ: ከመ — that, so that; as · 'like' before a noun (ከመ ምድረ በረድ 'like a land of hail') · ከመ ኢ- 'that not, lest' (ከመ ኢትንገሥ ብእሲት 'that a woman not reign'; ከመ ኢታቅሞ 'that you not make him stay') · 'as when' before ዘ- or አመ (ከመ ዘ ዐገትዋ 'as when they besieged her') · 'like one who' before ዘ- + preposition (ከመ ዘቦቱ 'like one who has')
ወበእንተ: በእንተ — and concerning, about (ወ- + preposition) · and on account of, because of (ወበእንተ እከዮሙ 'and because of their evil')
ወከማሁ: ከማሁ — and likewise (ወ- 'and' + adverb, 'like him, thus')
እመ: እመ — if (conjunction) · whether (ጐንደይኩ እመ ትገብእ 'I waited whether she would return') · in case, perhaps (እመ ይሁበከ እግዚኣብሔር ዘርአ 'perhaps God may give you offspring') · mother (እም, accusative, predicate: ወኮነተኪ እመ 'and she became a mother to you')
ወይቤሎሙ: ብህለ — and he said to them (ወ- + 3ms perfect ይቤ of b-h-l + -ሎሙ 'to them')
አልቦ: አልቦ — there is not, none (negative existential) · 'no, not so' as a reply (አልቦ እግዚኦ 'No, O lord', ch. 56)
ወካዕበ: ካዕበ — and again (ወ- + adverb) · 'and also, moreover' where it adds a further item (ወካዕበ ተቀብረ በህየ 'and he too was buried there', ch. 112)
ስምዑኒ: ሰምዐ — hear me! (G 2mp imperative with suffix 1cs -ኒ)
እንግርክሙ: ነገረ — that I tell you, let me tell you (1cs subjunctive, G + -ክሙ '2mp you')
ሀለዎሙ: ሀለወ — it is for them, they must, are set to (3ms perfect + -ሙ '3mp them'; impersonal) (?)
ንስቲተ: ንስቲት — a little, a short while (adverb, accusative)
አይሁድ: አይሁድ — the Jews (noun, plural; the dependent noun after the construct ሕዝበ) · nominative, subject or apposition (ኀተምዋ አይሁድ 'the Jews sealed it'; ዕዉራነ ልብ አይሁድ 'the Jews, blind of heart')
ወዘንተ: ዝንቱ — and this (ወ- + accusative ዘንተ, demonstrative)
ይገብር: ገብረ — he does, makes (3ms imperfect, G, g-b-r)
በፈቃዲ: ፈቃድ — by will (በ- + ፈቃድ 'will, desire'; the final -ዲ as written, perhaps for በፈቃዱ 'by his will') (?)
ደወለ: ደወል — boundary, border (noun; construct/accusative 'boundary of'; uncertain)
ንጉሠ: ንጉሥ — king (accusative) · also construct 'king of' (ንጉሠ ሮምሂ 'the king of Rome too') · predicate accusative 'as king' (ዘይከውን ንጉሠ 'who will be king'; ይኩነነ ንጉሠ 'may he be king for us') · accusative object 'a king' (ወለደት ሰማያዊ ንጉሠ 'she bore a heavenly king')
ሮምያ: ሮምያ — Rome (proper name, variant of ሮም)
ወንጉሠ: ንጉሥ — and king of (ወ- + noun, construct)
ወሊቀ: ሊቅ — and chief of (ወ- + noun, construct state; ወሊቀ ዲያቆናት 'and chief of deacons')
እንዘ: እንዘ — while, whilst (conjunction) · 'while', also 'though' in contrast (እንዘ ክቡር ስምነ 'though our name was honored')
ርቱዕ: ርቱዕ — right, fitting (adjective, used as predicate) · predicate before a subjunctive, 'it is right that' (ርቱዕ ንስግድ 'it is right that we bow')
ለሰብአ: ሰብእ — the men of (ለ- + noun, construct 'men-of'; the ለ- marks the object, doubling the suffix on the verb)
ወይትነሥኡ: ተንሥአ — and they will rise (ወ- + 3mp imperfect, Gt)
ፀብአ: ፀብእ — war, battle (noun, accusative) · also construct 'war of' (ፀብአ ሰይጣን 'the war of Satan') (?) · construct 'war of' (ፀብአ ዐማሌቅ 'the war of Amalek'; ፀብአ መሀይምናን 'the war of believers')
ወያመዘብሩ: መዘበረ — and they ravage, plunder (ወ- + 3mp imperfect; the form ya-ʾa-mäzäbbəru is the regular ʾa-stem (causative) imperfect of the quadriliteral መዘበረ 'plunder', or the plain stem is meant) (?)
ብሔሮሙ: ብሔር — their country, lands (noun, accusative + -ሙ '3mp their')
በህየ: ህየ — there, in that place (በ- + adverb)
ለአይሁድ: አይሁድ — to the Jews (ለ- + plural noun) · ለ- marking the object (ያስተኀፍርዎሙ ለአይሁድ 'they shame the Jews')
መንግሥተ: መንግሥት — kingdom (construct 'kingdom of') · also the plain accusative 'a kingdom' (ዘይነፍቅ መንግሥተ 'who would seize a kingdom')
ሐሳዌ: ሐሳዊ — false, lying (adjective; ሐሳዌ መሲሕ 'false Messiah')
ወእሙንቱሰ: እሙንቱ — and they, indeed (ወ- + 3mp pronoun + enclitic -ሰ)
ጳጳሳቲሆሙ: ጳጳስ — their bishops (noun, plural ጳጳሳት + -ሆሙ '3mp their'); ሊቃነ ጳጳሳቲሆሙ 'the chief bishops of their bishops'
ወያኀብሩ: አኀበረ — and they join (ወ- + 3mp imperfect, causative of ኀብረ)
ሃይማኖተ: ሃይማኖት — faith (noun, fem.; accusative) · construct 'faith of' (ሃይማኖተ ሮም 'the faith of Rome'; ሃይማኖተ ክርስቶስ 'the faith of Christ')
ወሰላመ: ሰላም — and peace (ወ- + noun; construct 'peace of')
ወይትካፈሉ: ተካፈለ — and they divide among themselves, share out (ወ- + 3mp imperfect, tä-stem of ከፈለ 'divide')
ምድረ: ምድር — earth, land (noun, construct state 'land-of') · accusative 'a land', 'the ground' (ምድረ ነኪረ 'a foreign land'; እከሪ ምድረ 'I dig the ground')
በከመ: ከመ — as, in the way that (በ- 'in' + ከመ)
ውስተ: ውስተ — in, within, into · to, among (ወለአከ ውስተ ኵሉ ነጋድያን 'and he sent to all the merchants') · at (ውስተ መድረከ ኆኃቲሃ 'at the threshold of her doors') · upon, on (ውስተ ሐቌያቲሆሙ 'upon their hips'; ውስተ መንበረ አቡሁ 'on his father's throne')
ቀዳሚ: ቀዳሚ — first (adj.) · adverbial 'first' after ኀበ (ኀበ ቀዳሚ ተወጠነ 'where it first began') · noun 'the first, the beginning' (በእንተ ቀዳሚ 'concerning the Beginning'; ቀዳሚ ትርጓሜሁ ክርስቶስ 'the beginning, its interpretation is Christ')
፩: ፩ — numeral 1 — chapter number · spoken አሐዱ (ʾäḥädu) 'one', in ch. 22 'a certain' (ወሀለወ ፩ ልብው 'there was a certain wise man') · 'one' of a number (ከመ ፩ እምአግብርቲከ 'as one of your servants') · 'one' as a pronoun, 'one … another' (ይነግሮ ፩ ለካልኡ 'one tells another'; ch. 53) · 'anyone' after a negative or ዘእንበለ (ዘእንበለ ያእምር ፩ 'without anyone knowing') · 'one' before ኅሊና (፩ ኅሊና 'one mind, of one mind'), spoken አሐዱ (ʾäḥädu), the masculine, since ኅሊና takes masculine agreement in this part (ባዕደ ኅሊና, በኅሊና ሠናይ)
ዘኀረዩ: ኀረየ — whom they chose (ዘ- relative + 3mp perfect, G)
ተ: ውስተ — final syllable of ውስተ 'into', split off by a stray wordspace (ውስ ፡ ተ); not a separate word
ዳዊት: ዳዊት — David (proper name) · 'ዳዊት' also in ማኅፈደ ዳዊት 'tower (?) of David' (genitive after a construct) · also the young prince Menelik, styled David (እግዚእክሙ ዳዊት 'your lord David')
ከማሁ: ከማሁ — likewise, like him (ከመ + -hu) · 'thus, so' answering ከመ (ከማሁ ታንጐደጒድ 'so it thunders')
ይነሥእ: ነሥአ — he takes (3ms imperfect, G, n-ś-ʾ)
ወይዴምር: ደመረ — and he joins, gathers (?) (ወ- + 3ms imperfect, d-m-r; the long ዴ- not explained; sense 'signals' a guess) (?)
በአምሳለ: አምሳል — in the likeness of (በ- + noun, construct አምሳለ)
፬: ፬ — 4, spoken አርባዕቱ (ʾarbaʿtu) 'four'; chapter number (numeral) · also a counted number 'four' (ውስተ ፬ መሳምክቲሃ 'in her four supports'; spoken አርባዕ ʾarbaʿ before a feminine plural, አርባዕቱ with a masculine)
ኀብሩ: ኀብረ — they gathered, assembled (3mp perfect, G, ḫ-b-r) · they agreed, conspired (3mp perfect, here of a wicked agreement)
ወአርትዑ: አርትዐ — and they made straight (ወ- + 3mp perfect, causative of ርትዐ 'be straight')
ይትማከሩ: ተማከረ — they take counsel with one another (3mp imperfect, tä-stem reciprocal of መከረ, m-k-r)
ኢትዮጵያሰ: ኢትዮጵያ — Ethiopia, as for Ethiopia (proper name + enclitic -ሰ 'as for', contrastive)
ወልደ: ወልድ — son (noun, construct state 'son-of') · accusative 'a son' (ወለደት ወልደ 'she bore a son')
ዘስሙ: ስም — whose name (ዘ- relative + noun 'name' + -ሁ '3ms his')
እስራኤል: እስራኤል — Israel (proper name; vocative) · dependent on a construct (ኀያላነ እስራኤል 'the mighty ones of Israel'; ch. 53) · also plain 'Israel', as subject or in ደቂቀ እስራኤል 'children of Israel' (ተሀየይዎ እስራኤል 'Israel ...', ch. 55–56)
ወይገብእ: ገብአ — and it will return, pass (ወ- + 3ms imperfect, G, g-b-ʾ)
ወሶበ: ሶበ — and when (ወ- + conjunction) · and Sobo (ወ- + proper name ሶበ, in the list of lands ruled by the Ishmaelites, ወሶበ ወኵርጒ; unidentified) (?)
በጽሐ: በጽሐ — he reached, arrived (3ms perfect, G, b-ṣ-ḥ) · with ይእቲ as apparent subject, 'it reached' her bearing, 'her time came' (ወይእቲኒ በጽሐ ወሊዶታ), a 3ms form where 3fs በጽሐት is expected (?)
ቤተ: ቤት — house (noun, construct state 'house-of') · accusative 'the house' as object of a verb (የኀድጋ ቤተ 'they leave the house')
ለእግዚኣብሔር: እግዚአብሔር — of/to God · God as object, marked with ለ- after ፈርሆ, አምዕዕዎ, አሥመሮ · also after a verbal noun ('fasting for God', 'offering to God') and as the owner after an anticipating suffix (ፈቃዱ ለእግዚኣብሔር 'God's will') · as object after ሰብሐ ('praise God', ይሴብሑ ለእግዚኣብሔር)
ፈድፋደ: ፈድፋደ — exceedingly, greatly (adverb) · 'especially' before a numeral (ፈድፋደ ፯ እምኔሆሙ 'especially seven of them') (?)
ሥጋሁ: ሥጋ — his body, flesh (+ -u) · 'the body of' before ለ- + a name (ሥጋሁ ለአማኑኤል 'the body of Emmanuel')
ገብአ: ገብአ — he returned (3ms perfect, G, g-b-ʾ)
የሐውር: ሖረ — he walks, goes (3ms imperfect, ḥ-w-r)
ልብ: ልብ — heart (noun; here the genitive in ሐዘነ ልብ 'sorrow of heart')
ወልዶ: ወልድ — his son (noun, accusative + -ሁ '3ms his', contracted)
ዘይንእስ: ንእሰ — who is younger, small (ዘ- + 3ms imperfect, n-ʾ-s)
ገብረ: ገብረ — make, do (3ms perfect) · here the noun ገብር 'servant' in the construct state, ገብረ ፈርዖን 'servant of Pharaoh' · accusative 'a slave' after አልቦ (ወአልቦ ገብረ 'and there is no slave')
መስቀል: መስቀል — cross (noun; genitive after the construct ዕፀ)
ወውእቱሰ: ውእቱ — and he, as for him (ወ- + pronoun + contrastive -ሰ)
ነገርዎ: ነገረ — they told him (3mp perfect + -ዎ '3ms him')
ለንጉሠ: ንጉሥ — of/for the king of (ለ- + construct) · ለ- marking the object, doubling -ኦ on the verb (ቀተሎ ... ለንጉሠ ኢሎፍሊ 'he killed him, the king of the Philistines')
ይመጽእ: መጽአ — he comes (3ms subjunctive, G, m-ṣ-ʾ)
ኀበ: ኀበ — to, toward, at; where (preposition / conjunction) · 'with, in the possession of' (ኢተርፈት ኀበ ኢዮርብዓም 'it did not remain with Jeroboam') · opening a title-like clause, 'how' or 'when' (ኀበ አስሐተቶ ለሰሎሞን ወለተ ፈርዖን 'how Pharaoh's daughter led Solomon astray') (?) · 'in the place of, as in' before a construct noun (ኀበ ነገረ ኢሳይያስ 'as in the word of Isaiah')
ወገብረ: ገብረ — and he did (ወ- + 3ms perfect, G, g-b-r)
ያነሥእ: አንሥአ — he will raise up (3ms imperfect, causative Aʾ-stem)
ወየሐውር: ሖረ — and he goes (ወ- + 3ms imperfect, G)
በኀበ: ኀበ — before, with, in the presence of (በ- + ኀበ) · among (በኀበ ማእምራን 'among the knowing') · 'where' (conj.) (በኀበ ሀለውኩ 'where I am') · 'of, from' after ሰአለ (ሰአሉ በኀበ እግዚኣብሔር 'they asked of God')
ባሕረ: ባሕር — sea (noun, accusative of place 'by sea') · accusative object or goal: 'reached the sea' (ወበጽሑ ባሕረ), 'crossed the sea' (ዐደዉ ባሕረ), 'came out of the sea' (ወወፅኡ ባሕረ), ch. 55 · construct 'sea of' (ባሕረ ኢርትራ 'the Sea of Erythra, the Red Sea')
ወበአሐቲ: አሐዱ — one (numeral; fem. አሐቲ; ወ- 'and' + በ- 'in')
ኀቤሁ: ኀበ — to him (preposition + -hu, ኀቤሁ) · also 'of him' after ሰአለ 'ask' (ሰአለ ኀቤሁ 'he asked of him') · 'with him, in his hand' expressing possession or disposal (እስመ ኀቤሁ ክብር ወኀሳር 'for with him are glory and loss')
ይብል: ብህለ — he says (3ms imperfect, G stem, defective verb b-h-l)
ወቆመ: ቆመ — and he stood (ወ- + 3ms perfect, q-w-m)
ወይቤሎ: ብህለ — and he said to him (ወ- 'and' + 3ms perfect ይቤ of b-h-l + -ሎ 'to him')
ይንሣእ: ነሥአ — that he take (3ms subjunctive, G) · let him take (3ms jussive, ሢመቶሂ ይንሣእ ባዕድ 'let another take his office')
ገሃደ: ገሃድ — openly, evident (adjective as adverbial accusative)
በኅቡእ: ኅቡእ — hidden, secret (adjective as noun; በኅቡእ 'in secret')
ኵሎሙ: ኵሉ — all of them (+ -omu) · before a noun, 'all' (ኵሎሙ አድያመ ኢትዮጵያ 'all the regions of Ethiopia', ch. 55) · 'all those' as antecedent of the relative እለ (እምነ ኵሎሙ እለ ፈጠረ 'above (?) all those whom he created')
ተዐደዉ: ተዐደወ — they transgressed (3mp perfect, tä-stem, ʿ-d-w; እለ ተዐደዉ 'those who transgressed')
ወአልቦ: አልቦ — and there is not (ወ- 'and' + negative existential)
ወይነብር: ነበረ — and he dwells (ወ- + 3ms imperfect, G)
ወአልቦሙ: አልቦ — and they have not (ወ- + negative existential 'there is not' + -omu)
በፍኖት: ፍኖት — on the road, in the way (በ- + noun, fem.)
ካዕበተ: ካዕበት — a second time, double (noun/adverb, accusative; from ካዕብ 'double'; ወወሰከ ካዕበተ 'he doubled', idiom uncertain) (?)
ሰብእ: ሰብእ — man, human being, people (noun) · 'humankind' (መፍቀሬ ሰብእ 'lover of humankind')
ዘጸልኦ: ጸልአ — what he hated (ዘ- + 3m sg perfect + -o, ṣ-l-ʾ)
ክብረ: ክብር — glory, honour (construct 'glory of') · accusative 'glory' (ወሀቦሙ ክብረ 'he gave them glory')
ወሞገሰ: ሞገስ — and majesty, favour, grace (ወ- + noun, accusative)
ወዐብየ: ዐብየ — and it grew, became great (ወ- 'and' + 3ms perfect, G, ʿ-b-y)
እምኵሎሙ: ኵሉ — than all of them (እም- comparative 'than' + ኵሎሙ)
ነገሥተ: ንጉሥ — kings (noun, plural ነገሥት, construct 'kings of') · accusative 'kings' as object (ያዐቢ ነገሥተ 'he makes kings great') · predicate 'as kings' (ኮኑ ነገሥተ 'they became kings', ?)
ለጽዮን: ጽዮን — of/for Zion · marking the object, doubled by the suffix on the verb (አንሥእዋ ለጽዮን 'they raised Zion') · naming the owner after a suffix (ምንባሪሃ ለጽዮን 'the seat of Zion'; እምላዕሌሃ ለጽዮን 'from upon Zion', ch. 56)
ታቦተ: ታቦት — ark, tabernacle (construct 'ark of') · also accusative 'an ark' (ግበር ታቦተ 'make an ark')
ሥምረቶ: ሥምረት — his good pleasure (noun + -ሁ '3ms his', anticipating ለእግዚኣብሔር)
ወያድኅነነ: አድኀነ — and he saves us (ወ- + 3ms imperfect, ʾa-stem, d-ḫ-n, + -ነ '1cp us'; verb አድኀነ 'save')
እመዐቱ: መዐት — from his wrath (እም- 'from' + noun 'wrath' + -ሁ '3ms his')
መንግሥቶ: መንግሥት — his kingdom (noun, f. + -ሁ '3ms his', accusative)
ወአውሥኡ: አውሥአ — and they answered (ወ- + causative 3mp perf., w-ś-ʾ)
በአማን: አማን — truth; በአማን 'in truth, truly' (በ- + noun)
ሠናየ: ሠናይ — good (accusative, adj. as noun) · adjective 'good, fine' agreeing with a noun (ልብሰ ሠናየ 'a fine garment')
ነበብከ: ነበበ — you have spoken, said (G 2ms perf.)
ተከሥተ: ከሠተ — it was opened, revealed (3ms perfect, tä-stem passive of ከሠተ)
ኵሎ: ኵሉ — all (accusative) · 'everything', used alone (እሰፍን ኵሎ 'I measure everything')
ዘኮነ: ኮነ — that which was (ዘ- 'that which' + 3ms perfect, k-w-n)
መጽሐፈ: መጽሐፍ — a book (noun, accusative) · construct 'book of' (መጽሐፈ ሕግ 'the book of the law', ch. 55)
ለነ: ለ — to us, for us (ለ- + 1cp suffix -ነ) · 'over us' (ንገሢ ለነ 'reign over us')
ዘእግዚኣብሔር: እግዚአብሔር — whom God (made king, etc.) (ዘ- 'the one whom' + noun as subject of the following verb; ዘእግዚኣብሔር አንገሠ 'whom God made king') · 'of God', ዘ- as genitive marker after a noun (ቤተ ክርስቲያን ዘእግዚኣብሔር 'the church of God') · 'of God' (ዘ- genitive 'of' + noun: ቃል ዘእግዚኣብሔር 'the Word of God') · 'of the Lord (is)', ዘ- marking the possessor before the thing possessed (ዘእግዚኣብሔር ሣህል 'the Lord's is mercy')
መሥዋዕተ: መሥዋዕት — offering, sacrifice (construct 'offering of') · also accusative 'a sacrifice' (ያዐርጉ መሥዋዕተ 'they offer a sacrifice') · predicate accusative 'as an offering' (ዘኮነ መሥዋዕተ 'who became an offering')
ይትገበር: ተገብረ — it is done (3ms imperfect, tä-stem passive of ገብረ)
ለኵሎሙ: ኵሉ — to all of them, all of them (ለ- + ኵሉ + -ሙ '3mp'; the ለ- marks the object)
ቅዱሳን: ቅዱስ — holy ones, holies (plural ቅዱሳን; ቅድስተ ቅዱሳን 'Holy of Holies') · adjective 'holy', plural, before or after a noun (ቅዱሳን ካህናት 'holy priests'; ለሐዋርያቲሁ ቅዱሳን 'to his holy apostles')
ወሰማዕት: ሰማዕት — and martyrs, witnesses (ወ- + noun ሰማዕት, read as plural) (?)
ለዓለመ: ዓለም — age, world, eternity (noun, construct state 'age-of'; ለ- 'for')
